stem: Which factor **BEST** describes the change in this population of finches?

options.label: B
options.text: A change in the reproductive success of one individual bird

options.label: C
options.text: A decrease in fitness that increased survival rates

options.label: D
options.text: A change in phenotype distribution because of an environmental factor

visual_elements: The bar graph shows the average beak depth (distance from the top of the beak to the bottom) of a population of finches. The data were collected in 1976 and in 1978, after a drought occurred in 1977 in the area.
y-axis labeled "Average Beak Depth (mm)" with values 0, 8, 9, 10
Bars for 1976 (similar to the previous 3 years) about 8.9 mm and 1978 (after a drought) about 9.8 mm
Source: Grant, Rosemary and Peter, BioScience, 2003
